method: Previously verified primary-source figures transcribed as a selected numerical extract. This file is not the original HTML/PDF or a complete industry/product table. The unmodified CE API response files are retained separately.

feed2025.scope: Alltech global compound-feed survey: 142 countries and 38,837 feed mills. Both numerator and denominator belong to this survey.

cornInputs2025_26.scope: USDA Mexico Post estimates/forecasts published in March 2026. Corn, primarily yellow corn for feed/starch, is an input; this is not the import dependence of manufactured feed or tortillas.

beerProduction2025.scope: BarthHaas compiled country production estimates; the world total is rounded. This is production, not the export ranking.

beerExports2025.scope: Mexican Agriculture Ministry beer-export publication and December 2025 agro-food balance. The article's 36% world-export value share is a 2021–25 average, not a 2025 single-year figure. Article figures were verified from the indexed official publication; full-body retrieval returned 403.

beerExports2024Wits.scope: Mexico-reported gross exports, HS H0 220300. Do not combine ratios with Data México's differently revised 2024 series.

tequila2024.unit: million litres as published by CRT
tequila2024.scope: A single CRT publication. No stock adjustment or origin-specific domestic-sales table; production minus exports is not domestic consumption. CRT and government 2025 totals differ, so 2025 values are not combined.

tequila2026FirstHalf.unit: million litres as published by CRT
tequila2026FirstHalf.scope: CRT's 24 July 2026 report; a half year, not the 2026 full year.

medical2024Wits.scope: HS H0 9018, medical/surgical/dental/veterinary instruments including electro-medical apparatus. Not all HS90 or all medical devices. Ranking is among the reported countries in the retrieved WITS table; EU aggregate excluded to avoid double counting.

catheters2024Wits.scope: HS H0 901839: needles, catheters, cannulae and the like, nes; a subset of HS9018. Trade quantities were not available in the retrieved table.

aeroEngineParts2024Wits.scope: HS H0 841191, parts of turbo-jets/turbo-propellers. Not the whole aerospace industry, assembled aircraft or all types of engines.

aeroAirframeParts2024Wits.scope: HS H0 880330, aircraft parts nes. Not complete aircraft. Current HS nomenclatures move parts into HS8807; no cross-version series is joined here.

preparedMeat2024Wits.scope: HS H0 1602, prepared/preserved meat, meat offal or blood. Excludes raw meat in HS02 and is not equivalent to the full SCIAN3116 industry.

apparel2024.scope: Data México national figures, HS2012 chapters61/62, displayed rounded to million USD. Worldwide comparison on these pages is 2022/OEC, so not a current world-production share.
